title: Tiveria Shabbos Controversy
body: Rav Dov Kook condemned public Shabbos desecration at Chof Gai, prompting a heated response from chareidi organizations and the Torah world.

title: Israel's Chief Rabbi Appointed
body: Israel's Ashkenazi Chief Rabbi Rav Kalman Meir Ber is named rov of Raananim Shul in Yerushalayim, replacing Rav Avigdor Berstein zt”l who passed away during Chanukah.
